label: Check the links of a page: parse, resolve, deduplicate, read robots.txt and judge the status (offline stand-in answers)
code:
from html.parser import HTMLParser from http import HTTPStatus from urllib.parse import urljoin, urldefrag, urlsplit, quote import urllib.robotparser as rp PAGE = '''

Books

fine broken elsewhere again mail no href

''' BASE = 'https://site.example/index.html' ANSWERS = {'https://site.example/ok.html': 200, 'https://site.example/gone.html': 404} # what a HEAD request would return class Links(HTMLParser): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.hrefs = [] def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs): if tag == 'a': self.hrefs.append(dict(attrs).get('href')) p = Links() p.feed(PAGE) print('raw hrefs:', p.hrefs) seen = [] for h in p.hrefs: if not h: continue url = urldefrag(urljoin(BASE, h))[0] if urlsplit(url).scheme not in ('http', 'https'): continue if urlsplit(url).netloc != urlsplit(BASE).netloc: continue if url not in seen: seen.append(url) print('to check:', seen) robots = rp.RobotFileParser() robots.parse(['User-agent: *', 'Disallow: /private/']) for url in seen: status = ANSWERS[url] verdict = 'allowed' if robots.can_fetch('*', url) else 'disallowed by robots.txt' print(url, verdict, status, HTTPStatus(status).phrase, 'BROKEN' if status >= 400 else 'ok') print('https://www.openstreetmap.org/search?query=' + quote('777 Valencia St, San Francisco'))
